player_prompt.intro:
Ngwena udi Mwana-Kalunga {player_id} mu SimpleTak.
Pa tabuleiro, mawe ya ngwena onekama '{player_stone}' na mawe ya ngwena mukwenu onekama '{opponent_stone}'.

Pa nginga ya ngwena, tchula uma kasitu kamwe (na numero yake) na ponda mawe ya ngwena kuna.
Kwa mfano, '[12]' ponda mawe ya ngwena mu kasitu 12.

Kimbundu ya ngwena ni kuunda njia ya mawe ya ngwena inayounganisha mabamba mawili ya kinyume (kutoka juu hadi chini au kutoka kushoto hadi kulia).

invalid_move.cell_out_of_range: Selu lisoli {cell_num}. Lizali kuwa na kati ya 0 na {max_board_num}.
invalid_move.cell_already_occupied: O kijimbuete {cell_num} mu kaxa, a i soneka ni kidimbu.

action.placement: Mwana {current_player_id} wakandile simbu yawo ({symbol}) mu selu {cell_num}.

outcome.winner: Mwana-Kalunga {current_player_id} ('{symbol}') akounganisha mabamba mawili ya kinyume!
